title: Effect of a structured exercise program on glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
authors: Smith J.; Doe A.; Lee K.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Exercise is recommended for type 2 diabetes. METHODS: We randomized 180 adults to a 12-week structured exercise program or usual care. RESULTS: HbA1c decreased by 0.6 percent in the intervention group. CONCLUSIONS: Structured exercise improved glycemic control.

title: Barriers to insulin adherence among adults with type 2 diabetes: a qualitative study
abstract: Semi-structured interviews with 32 adults with type 2 diabetes identified cost, injection fear and regimen complexity as major adherence barriers.

title: Flash glucose monitoring and hypoglycemia awareness in type 1 diabetes
authors: Novak P.; Haddad R.; Meyer U.
abstract: In a 6-month crossover study, flash glucose monitoring restored hypoglycemia awareness in 18 of 24 participants with impaired awareness.
